picks.title: Anthropic bites back in the compute wars with Amazon partnership
picks.why_it_matters: A $100B+ compute commitment signals AI infrastructure is becoming a winner-take-most game, raising the bar for AI startups competing on model capabilities and potentially creating opportunities for startups building efficiency-focused or vertical AI solutions.

picks.title: Qwen3.6-Max-Preview: Smarter, Sharper, Still Evolving
picks.why_it_matters: Alibaba's continued rapid iteration on open-weight frontier models intensifies competition and lowers barriers for startups building AI applications, while potentially commoditizing the model layer faster than expected.

picks.title: All phones sold in the EU to have replaceable batteries from 2027
picks.why_it_matters: Major hardware regulation creates market openings for startups in modular device design, sustainable battery tech, and circular economy services targeting the EU's 450M consumers.
